Show token usage statistics from .wombo-combo/usage.jsonl

Displays aggregated token usage data collected during agent runs. Can show totals or group by task, quest, model, provider, or harness. Supports date range filtering and table or JSON output. With --analytics, shows per-execution agent analytics from .wombo-combo/analytics/ (completion time, retries, full token totals, build pass rate, changed lines, usage coverage), grouped by task, quest, wave, agent, or model and filterable by --task, --quest, --wave.

Aliases: `us`

```sh
woco usage [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--by` |  | string |  | Group by field (default: total — no grouping). Token mode: task, quest, model, provider, harness. With --analytics: task, quest, wave, agent, model. Values: `task`, `quest`, `wave`, `agent`, `model`, `provider`, `harness`. |
| `--since` |  | string |  | Filter records from this date (ISO 8601, inclusive) |
| `--until` |  | string |  | Filter records until this date (ISO 8601, inclusive) |
| `--format` |  | string | `"table"` | Output format for usage data: table (default) or json. Values: `table`, `json`. |
| `--analytics` |  | boolean | `false` | Show per-execution agent analytics instead of token usage |
| `--task` |  | string |  | Only executions of this task ID (requires --analytics) |
| `--quest` |  | string |  | Only executions recorded under this quest ID (requires --analytics) |
| `--wave` |  | string |  | Only executions from this wave/session ID (requires --analytics) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
